# 2 Baruch Chapter 45 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** So take all of this to heart. Fix your minds on the law — and wisdom will teach you well.

**2** I, Baruch, say this to all of you who are here: hold firmly in your hearts everything I have told you, so that you don't forget it.

**3** For I know this for certain: the earth will change. The heavens will not stay as they are. The ages will pass away. The Most High will renew everything he has made.

**4** Those who have been made pure by wisdom will be transformed. Their faces will be turned into a blazing light of beauty. They will shine like the stars.

**5** Everything written in the law will be fulfilled. And everyone who has refused to believe will find themselves unable to resist it.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of Baruch's closing exhortation. The transformation passage (v.4) is the emotional climax: the faithful become radiant, star-like. The certainty expressed in v.5 is a powerful close — the law's fulfillment is inevitable, whether people believe it or not.*
